prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a full-fidelity desktop web application Home screen for Mazi, a signed-in memory archive for eight friends. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, straight screen capture, no device frame, no presentation-board annotations. This is a usable application, not a marketing website.
Visual direction: The Screening Room. Top 9% stable navigation: small elegant lowercase mazi wordmark left; Home (active), Timeline, Search centered; My Imports and a small circular group avatar right. Warm deep charcoal #211F1C background, ivory #F4EBDD text, restrained amber #CBA779 action highlight. Contemporary humanist sans for controls, large refined editorial serif for memory title. Warm, intimate, exceptionally art-directed.
Main region: upper left small text 'A LITTLE WHILE AGO'; beneath a modest heading 'Remember this?'. Center stage occupies middle 55%: a beautifully lit shallow 3D arrangement of THREE matte photographic planes, one dominant large front-facing landscape photo with crisp visible people, two smaller neighboring memory photos receding to left and right. Realistic very slight physical thickness and contact lighting; all planes remain legible, no swirling vortex, no planets, no physical projector, no cartoon model. Dominant photo: synthetic candid friends laughing on a Mediterranean seaside terrace at dusk, warm flash, deep cobalt sea, ordinary lived-in table. Neighbor images: a rainy city walk and a picnic. Center image is focal, not one of many equal tiles.
Below selected photo: left aligned to photo edge, serif title 'The night we missed the last ferry', next line 'Summer 2024 · 18 photos · Added by Deniz'. On the right of this caption row, a clear filled pale amber button 'Open memory' with dark text. Small conventional previous and next arrows beside a visible '1 / 3' position. All controls are flat HTML-like, never tilted in 3D.
Bottom 15%: quiet ruled region 'Recently added' with three compact photographic preview entries; maintain generous breathing room. Small unobtrusive 'Demo memories' label in footer to identify synthetic content. No fake social proof, activity metrics, public-sharing controls, publish button, likes, notifications, marketing headline, ornamental grain, exaggerated bloom or glass pills. Render precise readable UI, balanced generous spacing, exquisite photographic composition, strong depth but calm navigation.
